title: cyanthillium cinereum var. parviflorum
intro: Cyanthillium cinereum var. parviflorum, commonly known as Small-flowered Cyanthillium, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain, fever, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Cyanthillium cinereum var. parviflorum include antioxidant, antitumor, and antiviral activities, which may contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
